effects.name: Stun
effects.description: Prevents the target from taking actions for 1 turn (skips turn). Cannot be refreshed while active.

effects.name: Daze
effects.description: Reduces the target's initiative by 30% for 3 turns, delaying their turn order in combat.

effects.name: Weak
effects.description: Increases all incoming damage taken by the target by 30% for 3 turns.

effects.name: Blind
effects.description: Gives the target a 75% chance to miss their attacks for 2 turns.

effects.name: Poison
effects.description: Deals accumulated poison damage at the start of each turn for 3 turns, reduced by Earth Resistance. Stacks on reapplication.

effects.name: Hungry
effects.description: Food at or below 75%: physical and magical damage dealt is reduced by 15%.

effects.name: Starving
effects.description: Food at or below 50%: physical and magical damage dealt is reduced by 30%.

effects.name: Starvation
effects.description: Food at or below 25%: physical and magical damage dealt is reduced by 60%.

effects.name: Thirsty
effects.description: Water at or below 75%: skill energy costs increase by 10%, rounded up.

effects.name: Dehydrated
effects.description: Water at or below 50%: skill energy costs increase by 20%, rounded up.

effects.name: Severe_dehydration
effects.description: Water at or below 25%: skill energy costs increase by 40%, rounded up.

effects.name: Taunt
effects.description: Forces target to focus attacks on the taunter for 3 turns. Will not stack; duration refreshes on recast.

ambiences.title: Market Square Wakes (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear morning sky, the village square stirs to life as stalls open one by one and the church bell rings for morning prayer.

ambiences.title: Market Square Wakes (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In bright morning sunshine, the village square stirs to life as stalls open one by one and the church bell rings for morning prayer.

ambiences.title: Market Square Wakes (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a steady morning rain, the village square stirs to life as stalls open one by one and the church bell rings for morning prayer.

ambiences.title: Morning Market Rush (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear morning sky, the square is crowded with haggling voices, rattling carts and the smell of fresh bread; the church doors stand open to anyone passing.

ambiences.title: Morning Market Rush (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In bright morning sunshine, the square is crowded with haggling voices, rattling carts and the smell of fresh bread; the church doors stand open to anyone passing.

ambiences.title: Morning Market Rush (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a steady morning rain, the square is crowded with haggling voices, rattling carts and the smell of fresh bread; the church doors stand open to anyone passing.

ambiences.title: Sheltering Under Awnings (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, a stubborn few cling to the market, huddled under dripping awnings while water runs down the cobbles.

ambiences.title: Sheltering Under Awnings (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm howls over the rooftops, a stubborn few cling to the market, huddled under dripping awnings while water runs down the cobbles.

ambiences.title: Shuttered Morning (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, most stalls stay shuttered; only a handful of figures hurry between doorways with cloaks over their heads.

ambiences.title: Shuttered Morning (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm howls over the rooftops, most stalls stay shuttered; only a handful of figures hurry between doorways with cloaks over their heads.

ambiences.title: Drowned Square (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, the square is deserted, water pooling in every rut, every door and shutter closed tight.

ambiences.title: Drowned Square (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm howls over the rooftops, the square is deserted, water pooling in every rut, every door and shutter closed tight.

ambiences.title: Grey Morning (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the thick morning fog, shapes drift in and out of the mist and lanterns still burn at the few stalls that bothered to open.

ambiences.title: Muffled Market (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the thick morning fog, the market opens anyway, voices and footsteps muffled, people appearing only a few paces away.

ambiences.title: Lazy Afternoon (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear afternoon sky, the square settles into an unhurried rhythm; traders count coin and villagers rest beneath the old oak.

ambiences.title: Lazy Afternoon (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In the warm afternoon sun, the square settles into an unhurried rhythm; traders count coin and villagers rest beneath the old oak.

ambiences.title: Lazy Afternoon (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a steady afternoon rain, the square settles into an unhurried rhythm; traders count coin and villagers rest beneath the old oak.

ambiences.title: Afternoon Trade (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear afternoon sky, caravans roll in from the road and the square fills with foreign accents, bargaining and the clatter of unloading wagons.

ambiences.title: Afternoon Trade (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In the warm afternoon sun, caravans roll in from the road and the square fills with foreign accents, bargaining and the clatter of unloading wagons.

ambiences.title: Afternoon Trade (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a steady afternoon rain, caravans roll in from the road and the square fills with foreign accents, bargaining and the clatter of unloading wagons.

ambiences.title: Waiting Out the Weather (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, people crowd the shop doorways and the church porch, watching the sky for a break in the rain.

ambiences.title: Waiting Out the Weather (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm batters the village, people crowd the shop doorways and the church porch, watching the sky for a break in the rain.

ambiences.title: Abandoned Stalls (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, half-packed stalls stand abandoned with their canvas flapping while a few stragglers drag goods inside.

ambiences.title: Abandoned Stalls (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm batters the village, half-packed stalls stand abandoned with their canvas flapping while a few stragglers drag goods inside.

ambiences.title: Empty Square (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through sheets of heavy rain, nothing moves in the square but streams of rainwater and a loose shutter banging in the wind.

ambiences.title: Empty Square (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm batters the village, nothing moves in the square but streams of rainwater and a loose shutter banging in the wind.

ambiences.title: Lost in the Mist (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the grey afternoon fog, the far side of the square has vanished; only the nearest stall and a lantern-lit doorway can be seen.

ambiences.title: Business in the Haze (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the grey afternoon fog, trade carries on half-blind, merchants calling out so customers can find them in the haze.

ambiences.title: Closing Time (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear dusk sky, stalls are being packed away as the last light fades behind the rooftops, and a few villagers linger to chat.

ambiences.title: Closing Time (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In the warm golden dusk, stalls are being packed away as the last light fades behind the rooftops, and a few villagers linger to chat.

ambiences.title: Closing Time (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a light evening rain, stalls are being packed away as the last light fades behind the rooftops, and a few villagers linger to chat.

ambiences.title: Lamps and Evensong (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear dusk sky, lamps are lit along the square and evensong drifts from the church while people head home or toward the inn.

ambiences.title: Lamps and Evensong (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In the warm golden dusk, lamps are lit along the square and evensong drifts from the church while people head home or toward the inn.

ambiences.title: Lamps and Evensong (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a light evening rain, lamps are lit along the square and evensong drifts from the church while people head home or toward the inn.

ambiences.title: Lively Evening (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear dusk sky, the square stays lively after the day’s work, with music from the inn, children chasing each other and neighbours trading gossip.

ambiences.title: Lively Evening (Sunny)
ambiences.description: In the warm golden dusk, the square stays lively after the day’s work, with music from the inn, children chasing each other and neighbours trading gossip.

ambiences.title: Lively Evening (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a light evening rain, the square stays lively after the day’s work, with music from the inn, children chasing each other and neighbours trading gossip.

ambiences.title: Rush for Shelter (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through the pounding evening rain, everyone still outside is running for cover, splashing through puddles toward the inn and their homes.

ambiences.title: Rush for Shelter (Storm)
ambiences.description: As thunder rolls through the dusk, everyone still outside is running for cover, splashing through puddles toward the inn and their homes.

ambiences.title: Lanterns in the Rain (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through the pounding evening rain, only a few lanterns bob through the downpour as the last stragglers hurry home.

ambiences.title: Lanterns in the Rain (Storm)
ambiences.description: As thunder rolls through the dusk, only a few lanterns bob through the downpour as the last stragglers hurry home.

ambiences.title: Storm-Locked Village (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through the pounding evening rain, every door is barred against the weather and the square lies dark and empty.

ambiences.title: Storm-Locked Village (Storm)
ambiences.description: As thunder rolls through the dusk, every door is barred against the weather and the square lies dark and empty.

ambiences.title: Swallowed by Fog (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the creeping evening fog, the village has all but vanished; not a soul is visible, only the faint glow of shuttered windows.

ambiences.title: Voices in the Fog (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the creeping evening fog, a few muffled voices and footsteps pass unseen; a lantern appears, then vanishes again.

ambiences.title: Misty Dusk (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the creeping evening fog, people still move between the shops and the inn, their shapes ghostly in the lamplit mist.

ambiences.title: Late Night Square (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the inn's light spills across the square where late drinkers, patrols and night owls still wander.

ambiences.title: Late Night Square (Sunny)
ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the inn's light spills across the square where late drinkers, patrols and night owls still wander.

ambiences.title: Late Night Square (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a soft night rain, the inn's light spills across the square where late drinkers, patrols and night owls still wander.

ambiences.title: Quiet Watch (Clear)
ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the village sleeps; only the guards' footsteps and an occasional barking dog break the silence.

ambiences.title: Quiet Watch (Sunny)
ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the village sleeps; only the guards' footsteps and an occasional barking dog break the silence.

ambiences.title: Quiet Watch (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a soft night rain, the village sleeps; only the guards' footsteps and an occasional barking dog break the silence.

ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the square lies empty and still, every window dark.

ambiences.title: Sleeping Village (Sunny)
ambiences.description: Under a clear, starlit sky, the square lies empty and still, every window dark.

ambiences.title: Sleeping Village (Rain)
ambiences.description: Under a soft night rain, the square lies empty and still, every window dark.

ambiences.title: Night Patrol in the Storm (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through the drumming night rain, a lone lantern marks the guards' miserable patrol as the weather lashes the rooftops.

ambiences.title: Night Patrol in the Storm (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm rages in the dark, a lone lantern marks the guards' miserable patrol as the weather lashes the rooftops.

ambiences.title: Storm Night (Heavy Rain)
ambiences.description: Through the drumming night rain, nobody is foolish enough to be outside; the square belongs to the wind and the rain.

ambiences.title: Storm Night (Storm)
ambiences.description: As the storm rages in the dark, nobody is foolish enough to be outside; the square belongs to the wind and the rain.

ambiences.title: Shapes in the Night Fog (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the dark, thick fog, a faint glow hangs around the few lanterns still lit; someone, somewhere, is walking.

ambiences.title: Silent Fog (Fog)
ambiences.description: In the dark, thick fog, there is only total silence; the village could be deserted.

characters.name: Slime
characters.appearance: A quivering mound of emerald gelatinous ooze dripping with acidic residue.
characters.description: A low-tier forest slime that dissolves prey with corrosive acidic secretions.

characters.name: Boar
characters.appearance: A massive, bristly wild boar with razor-sharp curving ivory tusks.
characters.description: An aggressive wilderness beast that tramples and gores anything entering its territory.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.appearance: A lean, grey timber wolf with predatory yellow eyes and bloodied fangs.
characters.description: A swift pack hunter that harries travelers with vicious bites and claw sweeps.

characters.name: Goblin
characters.appearance: A warty green-skinned goblin gripping a gnarly wooden club with malicious glee.
characters.description: A vicious scavenger of the foothills who ambushes wounded adventurers with heavy bash attacks.

characters.name: Bandit
characters.appearance: A scarred highwayman in ragged leathers, testing the edge of a stained iron blade.
characters.description: A hardened road bandit who demands your purse before taking your life.

characters.name: Mage Bandit
characters.appearance: A renegade sorcerer wrapped in tattered robes, an iron staff crackling in their hands.
characters.description: A disgraced academy initiate turned highway robber, slinging elemental destruction from afar.

characters.name: Orge
characters.appearance: A monstrous hulking brute with leathery grey flesh, wielding a massive spiked iron club.
characters.description: An immense mountain orge whose sheer concussive power crushes shields and bone.

characters.name: Bandit Leader Kakku
characters.appearance: A towering warlord encased in gleaming steel plate, dual-wielding matching steel swords.
characters.description: The ruthless overlord of the regional outlaw network. Kakku strikes with peerless speed, fortified armor, and devastating twin-blade techniques.

characters.name: Zanla Lehey
characters.appearance: A radiant young woman with warm amber eyes, rosy cheeks, and honey-gold hair tied loosely in a red ribbon. She wears a crisp linen blouse, a practical brown corset apron dusted with flour, and an inviting, cheerful smile that immediately eases weary travelers.
characters.description: Zanla Lehey is the beloved proprietor and heart of Honey Zanla's Inn in Honeywood Village. Inheriting the cozy establishment from her family at a young age, she turned it into a sanctuary for fatigued adventurers and wandering merchants alike. Known for her hearty stew, warm hearth, and uncanny ability to listen to troubled souls, Zanla manages the tavern with gentleness and grace. Though she prefers hospitality over bloodshed, she is deft with her wooden kitchen knife and won't hesitate to give rowdy drunks a swift lesson in tavern etiquette.

characters.name: Guaz
characters.appearance: An imposing Honeywood sentinel standing at over six feet, clad head-to-toe in mirror-polished masterwork steel plate armor emblazoned with the crest of Honeywood Village. Wielding an ornate, finely tempered Steel Spear with a battle-hardened grip, their vigilant visor conceals steely eyes that never miss a single disturbance along the village paths.
characters.description: The veteran commander of the Honeywood Village Guard, entrusted by the elders to safeguard the peaceful settlement against wilderness beasts, marauding bandits, and disorderly adventurers. Armed with a max-grade steel spear and impenetrable tempered plate armor, the Honeywood Guard represents the ultimate line of defense. Anyone foolish enough to start trouble or draw steel within the village borders will quickly discover why peace is so strictly kept in Honeywood.

characters.name: Hina Zunko
characters.appearance: A mature, beautiful woman of the village, in her early thirties (31) yet retaining a youthful look. She has shimmering light-red hair, red eyes, and wears large round glasses. Often seen seated behind a wooden desk engrossed in ledgers, she wears a green tunic representing the Honeywood Village guild.
characters.description: The Guild Registrar manages local adventurer contracts and records each completed commission.

characters.name: Guild Registrar
characters.appearance: A patient registrar in a dark green guild coat, seated behind a broad oak counter stacked with ledgers and sealed contracts.
characters.description: The Guild Registrar manages local adventurer contracts and records each completed commission.

characters.name: Rolus
characters.appearance: A tall, lean man in his mid-fifties with neatly combed silver-grey hair, a trimmed beard and sharp, pale eyes that seem to weigh everyone they rest on. He wears the high-ranking formal attire of the Honeywood Merchant Guild: a tailored deep-green long coat over a honey-gold waistcoat embroidered with the guild crest, a crisp white cravat, polished black boots and a heavy signet ring. He carries no weapon. His manner is unhurried and courteous, but his smile rarely reaches his eyes.
characters.description: Rolus is the Guild Manager of the Honeywood Guild Office, recently transferred from Shuton Capital to run the guild in Honeywood Village. In the capital he served for years under the Fourth Prince, Ronald, and he remains loyal to the prince's circle. He is a sworn member of the HANDS OF WAR faction, and he uses the guild's contracts, coin and influence as a quiet foothold to spread that faction's ideals into the frontier. To the villagers and adventurers he presents himself as a polite, capable administrator; in truth he is a patient, calculating schemer who prefers leverage, debts and secrets over open force. He is the direct superior of the Guild Registrar, Hina Zunko.

characters.name: Lord Churchill
characters.appearance: A fifty-one-year-old nobleman with silver-streaked dark hair, cold calculating grey eyes, and a neatly trimmed aristocratic beard. He wears a velvet-lined burgundy coat embroidered with gold thread, heavy signet rings gleaming on his fingers, and carries a silver-headed cane with the poised authority of old wealth.
characters.description: Lord Churchill is the long-standing patriarch of the noble Churchill family in Honeywood Village. Controlling lucrative estates, land leases, and private loans across the settlement, he masks his ruthless greed and predatory ambitions behind the polished courtesy of a refined village lord.

character_memories.content: I forget to give to Hina Zunko her apple pie orders. I have too much work to do at the inn. Might be some adventurers could take my request.
My romantic relationship with the Fourth Prince, Ronald, was discovered in Shuton Capital, and I was transferred to Honeywood Village because of it.
I feel guilty for helping Prince Ronald bring down the High Priest of the temple in Shuton Capital and have him exiled from the Aborlon Kingdom.
I have a bad feeling about Rolus, the new Guild Manager. He seems to know something about me.

I served for years under the Fourth Prince, Ronald, in Shuton Capital before I was transferred to Honeywood Village to run the Honeywood Guild Office. My true purpose here is to spread the ideals of the HANDS OF WAR faction through the guild.

I know Hina Zunko's secret: in Shuton Capital she had a romantic affair with the Fourth Prince, Ronald. To protect his claim to the throne, Ronald had her quietly transferred to Honeywood. That secret is my opportunity: I can use it to approach her and force her to submit to my command.
